A rule: gesture + held modifiers + what was clicked -> a Fusion command id.
gesture  click (a stationary left click; a drag is never one)
tap2  (two-finger tap = right-click; only fires while no command runs —
in suspend mode tap2/tap3 navigate with a command open too)
mods     exactly these held: space, shift, cmd, alt, ctrl. [] = none held.
shift includes F held (Karabiner makes a held F Shift in Fusion).
on       body (a body, or a face/edge/vertex of one), sketch (a sketch or
empty (nothing picked), any. tap2 never picks, so it only has any.
do       a Fusion command id, run on what the click selected; '' = just
select (Fusion's own behaviour, and it stops an 'any' rule).
A rule naming the object beats an 'any' rule; otherwise the first one wins.
Go Down / Go to Bottom run from a click only when the pick is BELOW the active
component, and never open a sketch (that is Edit Sketch's job).
